name: Loyalty Transaction Totals 1
definition: Transaction totals during the reconciliation period, for a certain type of transaction.

POIGroupIdentification.name: POI Group Identification
POIGroupIdentification.definition: Identifier assigned by the merchant identifying a set of POI terminals performing some categories of transactions.

LoyaltyUnit.name: Loyalty Unit
LoyaltyUnit.definition: Unit of the amount, expressed in point or in a monetary value and a currency.

CardProductProfile.name: Card Product Profile
CardProductProfile.definition: Cards category related to the acceptance processing rules defined by the Loyalty provider.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency associated with the transaction totals.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Type of Loyalty transaction for Report.

TotalNumber.name: Total Number
TotalNumber.definition: Total number of transactions during a reconciliation period.

CumulativeAmount.name: Cumulative Amount
CumulativeAmount.definition: Total amount of a collection of transactions.

DetailedAmount.name: Detailed Amount
DetailedAmount.definition: Detailed amounts associated with the total amount of transactions.
